items.title: Marcos, Liza take time off to recharge
items.description: After hurdling hectic schedules before and during the Association of Southeast Asian Nations and Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summits, President Marcos took two days off to recharge and bond with First Lady Liza Marcos.

items.title: Senate ethics body to tackle Bato’s ‘unsigned’ response
items.description: The Senate ethics committee will tackle Sen. Ronald dela Rosa’s unsigned response to the complaint against him for his absences, according to committee chairman Senate President Pro Tempore Vicente Sotto III.

items.title: Philippines extends 14-day visa-free privilege for Chinese nationals
items.description: The Philippines has extended the 14-day visa-free entry privilege for Chinese nationals for another year, from Jan. 16, 2027 until Jan. 15, 2028, the Department of Foreign Affairs announced yesterday.

items.title: DA: Adequate pork supply until Q1 2027
items.description: The Department of Agriculture has given assurance that domestic pork stocks remain adequate to meet demand until the first quarter of 2027 despite concerns that a 60-day import ban could lead to a supply shortage.

items.title: Marcos gave ‘diplomatic’ response to Trump’s single-supplier proposal
items.description: President Marcos only gave a “diplomatic” response to US President Donald Trump’s suggestion that the Philippines source all its energy and agricultural imports from the United States, Philippine Ambassador to the US Jose Manuel Romualdez said.

items.title: VP defense struggling to find credible witnesses – prosecution
items.description: As the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte approaches its final stage, her defense team appears to be still struggling to get credible witnesses who can refute testimonies and documentary evidence presented by prosecutors, a spokesman for the House prosecution team said yesterday.

items.title: Gasoline down by P3 per liter, diesel by P2.60
items.description: Pump prices fall for the third consecutive week today, with gasoline down by P3 per liter, diesel by P2.60 per liter and kerosene, P1.60 per liter.

items.title: COA chair hurdles CA confirmation
items.description: Commission on Audit Chairman Douglas Michael Mallillin received the nod of the Commission on Appointments yesterday despite an initial protest from one of the senators.

items.title: Forex exec in Romualdez case eyed as state witness
items.description: The Office of the Ombudsman has asked the Sandiganbayan to allow the removal of foreign exchange executive Felicito Guevarra from the list of accused in the plunder case against former House speaker Martin Romualdez.

items.title: Senate begins plenary debates on budget bill
items.description: The Senate now girds for marathon floor debates on the P7.2-trillion national budget for next year, with its finance committee’s submission to the plenary of the chamber’s version of the 2027 General Appropriations Bill.
